status: RETRACTED — inconclusive. See `retraction` below before citing any numbers from this file.

retraction.summary: Native baseline phase (multirun_baseline_v2_30_multi_sample.json) collapsed: every PR in every run returned 0 comments / 0 tokens due to silent `gh pr diff` failures masked by BareClaudeCodeReviewer's old fall-through-to-empty-Review behaviour (now fixed in peer-7op). Reconstructing against the 'good' preserved baseline (multirun_baseline_e45fe88.json) was invalid because that baseline was N=5 against only 7 PRs, not 30 — different PR populations. Earlier 'KEEP' and 'mild-keep, poor-bang-for-buck' claims are withdrawn.

what_changed_under_corrected_primitives.honest_read: After polarity + CI corrections, the only quality metric clearing the CI is novelty_rate (+0.063). detection_rate and recall are statistically indistinguishable from zero. The two big 'wins' (sev_calib, suggestion_rate) are structured-output format artifacts. The cpp regression is real. Not a clear keep.
